notes: Prepare Context phone 0.1.28/code29 and independent Watch 0.1.11/code100012. The phone header uses static closed/open arrow loops for active/idle synchronization while preserving error details. Watch notes and durable local acknowledgements take priority over full-day snapshots, without waiting for cloud synchronization. Watch dictation stays inside Context with a live clock and prefers an available on-device speech service; system voice is an explicit fallback and offline recognition depends on installed service support. Watch microphone access requires a user-initiated runtime permission. Consent, immutable operation IDs, local commit-before-acknowledgement, source revisions and encrypted calendar/storage checks remain protected. Exact reviewed Wear-source removal inventories, independent builds, actual native class definitions and publisher-certificate checks must pass before availability records change. Physical devices, live speech/transport, Apple/Google stores and official F-Droid inclusion require separate confirmation.
